source_evidence: D327~15:10 exact player 'That would be lovely' accepts Sallow's offer to ask the route broker for an introduction to Demeric Harthvale, not an actual meeting, purchase, investment, payment, illegal contract, disclosure of evidence, or promise to use the service. Sallow willingly agrees to send word to the broker requesting a commercial introduction and asks where he should send the reply: 'Very good. I'll ask the broker to speak with Harthvale on your behalf. Where shall I send word once I have an answer?' This is an accepted ordinary NPC intention, not actual dispatch, receipt, Harthvale's agreement or verified availability. No need for another contested check because prior successful Deception29 obtained the offer. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar remain in same business room; V controls whether and what contact address to provide. Existing Tavosk letter remains V-held. Desen has not been told of afternoon findings. No other change except brief elapsed dialogue.
